title: perf(canary): automated auto-detection for latency/throughput regressions + rollout guards
author: Riley Chen
description: Context: Canary runs occasionally miss subtle latency/throttle regressions that don't fail unit tests but degrade tail latency and throughput. This PR adds an automated detection pipeline that continuously analyzes canary traces and aggregated latency/throughput time series, raising deterministic regression events and gating rollouts with hysteresis-based rollout guards. Motivation: make perf canaries actionable and automate safe rollouts when regressions are detected. Scope: detection engine (sliding-window statistical detector + EWMA baseline), rollout guard controller (policy evaluation, canary pause/rollback), observability (per-canary metrics, alerting rules), tests (unit + integration harness), and docs/runbook. Changes include: 1) perf/canary/detector.py: new detector with configurable sensitivity and hysteresis; 2) deploy/rollout/guard_controller.go: evaluates detector events and enforces canary pause/rollback policies with exponential backoff; 3) observability/metrics_registry.yaml: added canary_latency_95, canary_throughput_drop_pct, canary_regression_events; 4) tests/perf/test_canary_alerts.py: end-to-end tests using synthetic regression traces; 5) docs/perf/canary.md: runbook and threshold guidance; 6) CI: extended perf pipeline with long-run sampling. Checklist: [x] detector implementation [x] guard controller [x] tests (unit+integration) [x] docs and runbook [x] canary dashboard panels [x] Linear/INC linked. Notes: sensitivity defaults tuned conservatively; operators can override thresholds per-customer and per-model.

backward_compatibility: This change is opt-in behind a feature flag and does not change existing canary APIs. Customers with custom rollout policies unaffected unless they opt-in.
estimated_rollout_plan: Week 1: enable in staging for all models behind flag. Week 2: enable for internal tenants. Week 3-4: gradual enablement for hosted customers with conservative defaults. Monitor metrics and alerts.
